scope: One clean-device Android 10 / Lynx SDK 4.2 lifecycle cohort for the immutable current-product structural Element Template bundle at 10,000 rows. Each of five independent cold launches ran create, clear, and recreate on one page. This is correctness, bounded-owner, and operation-latency evidence at n=5; it is not a process-memory/GC, Android 11+, higher-scale, native-list, no-JIT, low-end, iOS, cross-framework, or default-switch claim.

protocol.mainBoundary: compact product receiver frame application through ACK and complete dispatch
protocol.devtool: disabled by a background-only preflight before every attempt; no CDP connection used
protocol.input: native ADB taps at the registered create and clear controls
protocol.semanticOracle: 0 to 10,000 rows, 10,000 to 0 rows, then 0 to 10,000 new rows; exact ids at each populated state; one transport ACK; two native frames; strict ownership census; and no observed error

sanitization: This compact record excludes the raw device endpoint, local paths, per-event timestamps, process IDs, raw log lines, and generated row labels.

decision.createClearRecreate: stable correctness and bounded-owner gate passed at n=5: all 15 operations completed on the first attempt with exact state, ACK, two frames, and the expected ownership census
decision.ownerLifecycle: clear returned live logical ownership to the rows-0 baseline while retaining one bounded 10,000-handle / 40,000-host-ref recycle pool; recreate consumed that pool and restored the populated census exactly
decision.latencyComparison: not claimed because this is a single-cell cohort; recreate is reported as an operation result, not attributed causally to recycling
decision.memoryQualification: not claimed because Android 10 lifecycle census is not fresh-process peak, settled, after-clear, post-GC process memory on the required Android 11+ runtime
remaining: 20-cycle fresh-process peak, settled, after-clear, and post-GC memory on one Android 11+ device/runtime cohort
behavior above 10,000 rows within the resident native-node budget or through native-list virtualization
registered update-every-tenth, select, swap, remove, and storm operations plus native-list
iOS correctness, latency, memory, and bytecode evidence
